turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I take daily medication. What do I need to know for flying abroad?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Always pack it in your hand luggage, in its original packaging with the label on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, something else. It's a bank holiday weekend, so three whole days.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lovely. You could squeeze in a short trip somewhere, or finally do those jobs around the house. Which would make you happier on Tuesday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, I need a quick chat with my colleague. Not a word from you till I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, do we still have garlic or did you use the last of it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think there's half a bulb in the cupboard by the kettle.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Half a bulb won't be enough. Could you grab some on your way back from work?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, anything else while I'm there?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe a lemon. And check if they have fresh parsley.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, which shoes should I wear, the black or the brown?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The brown, they go with the jacket.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry about that, done with him now. Over to you.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. So, three days. Getting away, or catching up on the house?
